## Affected Lesson
- **Course**: [e.g., Linux Fundamentals]
- **Module**: [e.g., File Permissions & Ownership]
- **Lesson Slug / URL**: [e.g., `/learn/linux-fundamentals/file-permissions`]

## Nature of Improvement
- [ ] Technical inaccuracy or outdated explanation
- [ ] Typo / formatting fix
- [ ] Additional code example or terminal output
- [ ] Knowledge check correction or enhancement
- [ ] External reference / documentation link update

## Proposed Change
Provide details of the modification, including proposed text or code snippet replacements.

## Authoritative References
Links to Linux kernel documentation, man pages, RFCs, or standard specifications supporting this change.
